verdict.rationale: Baseten's docs describe installing official Baseten MCP servers so a coding agent can manage the Baseten workspace and search the docs, and a probe confirms the MCP server is documented at docs.baseten.co/agent-setup. The core of the story is delivered, but the depth of the server's capabilities is thinly evidenced. Missing for 10: documented tool catalog/scope of workspace operations, auth and setup details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
